events.organization: Postpartum Support Center & West Marin Fund
events.address: 1 Bear Valley Visitor Center Access Rd, Point Reyes Station, CA 94956
events.description: A picnic for expecting families and families with children ages 0-5, hosted by the Postpartum Support Center and West Marin Fund. Surprise gift bags, arts & crafts, games & family activities, books for children, and food & refreshments. 10:00 AM–12:00 PM.
events.registration: Required — RSVP (QR code on flyer; call (415) 320-6707 with questions)
events.notes: Added 2026-08-17 from the organization's own Instagram flyer (@postpartumsupportcenter), not a secondhand roundup. Not found on postpartumsc.org's own pages as of this add — not unusual for a small one-off community event promoted mainly via Instagram/QR RSVP; the flyer's phone number (415-320-6707) matches PPSC's number found independently via web search, which is why this was added despite no independent listing.
events.event_name_es: Picnic de West Marin
events.description_es: Un picnic para familias embarazadas y familias con niños de 0 a 5 años, organizado por Postpartum Support Center y West Marin Fund. Bolsas de regalo sorpresa, manualidades, juegos y actividades familiares, libros para niños, y comida y refrescos. 10:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

events.description: Family festival under the redwoods to celebrate the spirit of the village. Live music, a DJ set, children's nature crafts, aerial performances, a vendor village, and a Fall Equinox family ritual, plus a Toddler Grove and Wee Yogis Music Class for the youngest kids and a Mama Sanctuary for pregnant and nursing mothers. Bring your own picnic. Sponsored by the Fairfax Parks & Recreation Commission. No drop-off childcare — parents/caregivers responsible for their children throughout. 3:30–7:30 PM.
events.notes: Added 2026-08-20 from a posted flyer, confirmed against themamatree.org (time 3:30–7:30 PM not on the flyer itself — pulled from the site). Venue address reused from the existing 'Song Circle with Amber' records (ids 741/742), which already established Redwood Stage as 16 Park Rd, next to Peri Park.
events.event_name_es: Festival Familiar de Otoño de Fairfax
events.description_es: Festival familiar bajo las secuoyas para celebrar el espíritu del pueblo. Música en vivo, DJ, manualidades infantiles de naturaleza, actuaciones aéreas, un mercado de vendedores y un ritual familiar de equinoccio de otoño. Trae tu propio picnic. 3:30–7:30 PM.

events.description: Tacos, margs, house music to dance to; billed as an easy Friday night hang, "perfect way to kick off back 2 school." Free entry. 5:30–9:00 PM.

events.description_es: Tacos, margaritas, música house para bailar; un relajado plan de viernes por la noche, "la manera perfecta de arrancar el regreso a clases." Entrada gratuita. 5:30–9:00 PM. Evento para adultos.

events.event_name_es: Hora del Cuento: Libros y Burbujas
events.description: Join us every other Wednesday for Books & Bubbles Storytime with Teacher Carrie! We'll read, sing, build social-emotional skills, and, of course, pop bubbles! Hosted outdoors on the lawn when weather is warm and dry.
events.description_es: ¡Únete a nosotros cada dos miércoles para la Hora del Cuento Libros y Burbujas con la maestra Carrie! Leeremos, cantaremos, desarrollaremos habilidades socioemocionales y, por supuesto, ¡haremos burbujas! Se realiza al aire libre en el césped cuando el clima es cálido y seco.
events.notes: 2nd, 4th, and 5th Wednesdays of each month — alternates with id 12 (Music & Movement Story Time with Colors of Spanish), which covers the library's other Wednesday storytime slot each month. Confirmed live 2026-08-20 (Sep 9, 23, 30 match; also consistent with the older date list from open item 29 — Oct 14/28, Nov 25, Dec 9). Resolves item 29.

events.event_name: Read to a Dog: A Marin Humane Society Program
events.event_name_es: Lee a un Perro: Programa de la Sociedad Humanitaria de Marin
events.description: Dogs are ideal reading companions because they offer unconditional love and acceptance. Emerging and new readers are welcome to practice reading aloud with our volunteer dogs. Recommended for children of all abilities, grades K and up. Registration required — sign up at the Children's Desk the day of the event.
events.description_es: Los perros son compañeros de lectura ideales porque ofrecen amor y aceptación incondicionales. Los lectores nuevos y emergentes son bienvenidos a practicar la lectura en voz alta con nuestros perros voluntarios. Recomendado para niños de todas las habilidades, desde kindergarten en adelante.
events.registration: Required — sign up at the Children's Desk the day of the event
events.notes: 2nd Thursday of each month. Confirmed live 2026-08-20 — four listed forward dates (Sep 10, Oct 8, Nov 12, Dec 10) all independently verified as the 2nd Thursday of their month.

events.event_name_es: Ayuda Con La Tarea
events.description: Created and run by high school students and the Marin County Free Library, offering free one-on-one homework help sessions for students in grades 3 through 11.
events.description_es: Creado y dirigido por estudiantes de secundaria y la Biblioteca Libre del Condado de Marin, ofrece sesiones gratuitas de ayuda individual con la tarea para estudiantes de 3.º a 11.º grado.
events.notes: Only observed starting Sep 16 in the Aug 21–Oct 1 confirmation window — may be a semester-timed start rather than a true gap; worth re-checking on the next sweep. Not the same program as id 776 (Belvedere-Tiburon, a different branch).

events.description: Celebrate Family and Community Day at the Novato Library! Create a special card for a family or community member — supplies provided. Join us after school in the kids' room. Sponsored by the Friends of the Novato Library.
events.description_es: ¡Celebra el Día de la Familia y la Comunidad en la Biblioteca de Novato! Crea una tarjeta especial para un familiar o miembro de la comunidad — los materiales serán proporcionados. Únete a nosotros después de la escuela en la sala infantil.
events.notes: Confirmed live 2026-08-20 — no other dates listed on the source page.
